title: The Complete Soccer Performance Program
subtitle: A practical training plan to help soccer players build the strength, speed and confidence they need to perform at their best.
intro: This program gives you a clear, structured path to improve the physical qualities that matter most on the soccer field. Each phase is designed to complement soccer practice while helping you train with purpose.

highlights.title: Build strength
highlights.description: Develop the force and control needed to sprint, jump, change direction and compete.

highlights.title: Move with confidence
highlights.description: Improve coordination, mobility and athletic movement so you can play freely.

highlights.title: Train with purpose
highlights.description: Follow a progressive plan that fits alongside your practices, matches and recovery.

sections.title: Who this program is for
sections.content: This program is designed for developing and competitive soccer players who want a clear plan for improving their physical performance. It can be adapted to different ages, training histories and competition schedules.

sections.title: What you will work on
sections.content:
- Strength and power
- Acceleration and sprint mechanics
- Change of direction and agility
- Mobility, coordination and resilience
- Recovery and training consistency

download.label: Download the program
download.description: Get the complete program guide and start building your plan today.

cta.title: Ready to train with a plan?
cta.text: Reach out to discuss your goals and find the right next step for your development.
